waste_trade_propensity_authority.derivation: 2019 source-input import or export mass divided by same-region local pre-trade collected waste
waste_trade_propensity_authority.execution_order: after stock outflow and collection-rate resolution; before discard-share splitting and REMIND-MFA 0.2.0 Trade.balance(to="maximum")

value_modes.retain_default: Use each future year's exact default value.
value_modes.multiplier_from_default: Multiply each future year's exact default by the persistent rule.
value_modes.delta_from_default: Add the persistent rule to each future year's exact default.
value_modes.retain_2019: Use the same-coordinate exact 2019 default as a future reference.
value_modes.delta_from_2019: Add the persistent rule to the same-coordinate exact 2019 default.
value_modes.retain_2019_propensity_pretrade_collecte: For waste imports or exports only, retain the exact 2019 source-input propensity to current-year local pre-trade collected waste; the annual mass is resolved during MFA execution.
value_modes.retain_default_propensity_pretrade_colle: For waste imports or exports only, follow the contemporaneous REMIND-MFA default source-input propensity to current-year local pre-trade collected waste; the annual mass is resolved during MFA execution.

parameters.meaning: Annual plastics-in-use stock target solved by the stock-driven cohort model.
parameters.transition: From the first changed year, preserve prior-year closing cohorts, calculate their survival, and solve nonnegative new inflow for each annual stock target.
parameters.upstream_translation: pyToCE continues surviving cohorts and uses FLODYM StockDrivenDSM for each new cohort; a direct stock target replaces the corresponding annual target.

parameters.meaning: Mean of the FLODYM log-normal service-life distribution by good.
parameters.transition: In each active year, condition survival on prior-year closing stock using that year's mean and proportional standard deviation. Cohorts retain their original entry year.
parameters.upstream_translation: The exact completed cohort state continues prospectively from input release 1.0.0.

parameters.meaning: Lifetime standard deviation in years, derived from the resolved mean to preserve the original coefficient of variation for each good.
parameters.transition: In each active year, condition survival on prior-year closing stock using that year's mean and proportional standard deviation. Cohorts retain their original entry year.
parameters.upstream_translation: The exact completed cohort state continues prospectively from input release 1.0.0.

parameters.meaning: Share of actual occurrence-year discard that is collected.
parameters.transition: Apply to discard occurring in the active year, including legacy cohorts.
parameters.upstream_translation: Resolved annual values update copied source parameter arrays at their exact coordinates before the direct pyToCE calculation; historical source inputs remain unchanged.

parameters.meaning: Share of all collected waste after trade sent to mechanical recycling.
parameters.transition: Apply to all collected waste after trade in the active treatment year.
parameters.upstream_translation: Resolved annual values update copied source parameter arrays at their exact coordinates before the direct pyToCE calculation; historical source inputs remain unchanged.

parameters.meaning: Share of all collected waste after trade sent to chemical recycling; allocation is restricted to eligible polyolefin constituents.
parameters.transition: Apply to all collected waste after trade in the active treatment year.
parameters.upstream_translation: Resolved annual values update copied source parameter arrays at their exact coordinates before the direct pyToCE calculation; historical source inputs remain unchanged.

parameters.meaning: Share of all collected waste after trade sent to incineration.
parameters.transition: Apply to all collected waste after trade in the active treatment year.
parameters.upstream_translation: Resolved annual values update copied source parameter arrays at their exact coordinates before the direct pyToCE calculation; historical source inputs remain unchanged.

parameters.meaning: Material-family share assigned to new stock inflow by region and good.
parameters.transition: Prospective schedules apply only to entering cohorts; every surviving cohort keeps its material identity.
parameters.upstream_translation: The cohort calculation assigns each future entering cohort its annual material shares.

parameters.meaning: Annual waste imports in the 12 world regions allocated by the upstream material/good split; the deferred propensity mode resolves annual mass from current-year local pre-trade collection.
parameters.transition: Apply in the actual waste-trade year; the deferred mode uses current-year local pre-trade collected waste for each region.
parameters.upstream_translation: Resolve annual amounts in the 12 world regions, including deferred amounts from current-year local collection; split by the discard material, element and good shares, then apply the public REMIND-MFA 0.2.0 Trade.balance(to="maximum") calculation and pyToCE admission.

parameters.meaning: Annual waste exports in the 12 world regions allocated by the upstream material/good split; the deferred propensity mode resolves annual mass from current-year local pre-trade collection.
parameters.transition: Apply in the actual waste-trade year; the deferred source export must be at most current-year local pre-trade collected waste.
parameters.upstream_translation: Resolve annual amounts in the 12 world regions, including deferred amounts from current-year local collection; split by the discard material, element and good shares, then apply the public REMIND-MFA 0.2.0 Trade.balance(to="maximum") calculation and pyToCE admission.

parameters.meaning: Biogenic share of derived virgin production. This selects virgin-feed production routes. The nominal feedstock report applies this share to its separately defined polymer equivalent.
parameters.transition: Apply to virgin production occurring in the active year.
parameters.upstream_translation: Resolved annual values update copied source parameter arrays at their exact coordinates before the direct pyToCE calculation; historical source inputs remain unchanged.

parameters.meaning: Atmospheric-carbon DACCU share of derived virgin production. This selects virgin-feed production routes. The nominal feedstock report applies this share to its separately defined polymer equivalent.
parameters.transition: Apply to virgin production occurring in the active year.
parameters.upstream_translation: Resolved annual values update copied source parameter arrays at their exact coordinates before the direct pyToCE calculation; historical source inputs remain unchanged.

parameters.meaning: Point-source capture is unsupported; the REMIND-MFA input must retain its zero default.
parameters.transition: Point-source carbon capture is fixed at the zero default in the direct pyToCE MFA. The listed source equation and dependencies document the original REMIND-MFA control.
parameters.upstream_translation: The source adapter retains the zero default for point-source carbon capture. DACCU is a separate virgin-feedstock route.

technical_process_reference.activity: carbon dioxide, captured, at municipal solid waste incineration plant, for subsequent reuse

parameters.meaning: SSP2 population driver used to derive stock targets from socioeconomic projections.
parameters.transition: Apply prospectively to the stock projection; retain historical population and stock.
parameters.upstream_translation: Future coordinates are applied before PlasticsModel.get_long_term_stock.

parameters.meaning: SSP2 GDP-per-capita driver used to derive stock targets from socioeconomic projections.
parameters.transition: Apply prospectively to the stock projection; retain historical GDP and stock.
parameters.upstream_translation: Future coordinates are applied before PlasticsModel.get_long_term_stock.

parameters.meaning: Completed annual in-use stock after cohort computation.
parameters.transition: Calculated by the MFA.
parameters.upstream_translation: Extract from completed stock/cohort result.
parameters.upstream_source: FLODYM 0.8.1 StockDrivenDSM.compute; pyToCE conditional cohort continuation

parameters.meaning: Nonnegative new stock inflow solved from target stock and cohort survival.
parameters.transition: Calculated by the MFA.
parameters.upstream_translation: Extract new inflow from the default stock reconstruction or the FLODYM new-cohort solve within pyToCE continuation, then apply entering-cohort material shares.

parameters.meaning: Annual cohort-resolved material leaving in-use stock.
parameters.transition: Calculated by the MFA.
parameters.upstream_translation: Extract from completed cohort solver.
parameters.upstream_source: FLODYM 0.8.1 StockDrivenDSM.compute; pyToCE conditional cohort survival

parameters.meaning: Material reaching end of life in its year of occurrence.
parameters.transition: Calculated by the MFA.
parameters.upstream_translation: Extract from use-to-EOL flow.

parameters.meaning: Reported direct landfill share of all collected waste after trade, excluding mechanical-recycling rejects; undefined when total treatment is zero. A supplied scenario value only asserts the residual of the active treatment controls.
parameters.transition: Check the active-year residual calculated from the other treatment controls.
parameters.upstream_translation: The compiler checks a supplied control residual. The result reports collected-to-landfill mass divided by the sum of the four direct collected-waste treatment routes.

parameters.meaning: Locally collected occurrence-year discard by material family, pooled over goods and before waste trade.
parameters.transition: Calculated by the MFA.
parameters.upstream_translation: Extract from EOL-to-collected flow.

parameters.meaning: Usable secondary resin before product conversion, summed from the fixed recovery of each eligible constituent. Chemical monomers are reported separately in material realization.
parameters.transition: Calculated by the MFA.
parameters.upstream_translation: Allocate available waste jointly with chemical recycling under constituent compatibility and gross receiving-demand limits, then sum recovered resin by material family.

parameters.meaning: New polymer produced for domestic processing and primary export, after mechanically recovered resin. Polymer made with recovered chemical monomers remains new polymer here.
parameters.transition: Calculated to satisfy constituent processing and export demand after mechanical recovery.
parameters.upstream_translation: Sum N_k = new_polymer_domestic_k + new_polymer_export_k by material family. F_family is finished manufacturing demand including intermediate exports; theta_k is constituent k's family share; w_ko is its finished-output portfolio share for operation o; g_o is kg principal feed/kg finished output; G_k is gross constituent feed and N_k is new polymer, both in Mt Plastic.
coupled_equations: allocated_LCI_demand = A * new_polymer with recovered and virgin monomer fractions
